note: Stray trouble at the town edge: the wilderness safety zone around Mosslight is relaxed at the outskirts only. Once in a while a lone wolf, slime or rat wanders into the edge of town and picks a fight with whoever it finds there — townsfolk fight back or flee, guards move in, and the body is lootable like any other kill. The plaza and market heart stay completely safe: strays arrive only at the outskirts and their hunting range cannot reach the town center
